title: Turn a proof gap into a focused review
canonical_state: OpsTruth project queue in Proof & State GTM vault

source.angle: Use missing-check evidence to define a focused diagnostic review rather than another confidence claim.

intent.audience: Founders and agencies reviewing AI-built applications
intent.objective: Prompt report use and qualified diagnostic-review conversations
intent.cta: Identify the part of the application whose testing is uncertain

assistance.disclosure: Based on the documented diagnostic-review workflow; no new release or customer result is claimed.

claim_boundary: A report is not a security certification, complete production audit, legal assurance or repair. No pricing, free review or guaranteed outcome is offered.
